market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely choppy 1-3 months as Fed hike digests. Oil weakness supports equities but rate pressure caps upside. Semiconductor momentum may extend but AI valuation risk creates volatility. Turkey crisis and geopolitical headlines add tail risk. Expect Nasdaq to outperform Dow on AI leadership but with wider swings.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook moderately constructive if inflation stabilizes post-hike. AI infrastructure capex cycle remains multi-year. Consumer bifurcation persists. Energy transition (LNG, data center power) creates structural winners. Geopolitical fragmentation is a persistent drag on global risk appetite. Fed 'higher for longer' compresses multiples on long-duration growth.
